response.original_title: ((Complete FAQ))- How do i book multiple rooms on MSC Cruise?
response.overview: You can book multiple rooms on MSC Cruises by calling customer service, +1-866 829-1280(US) using a travel agent, or making separate online bookings. Speak with an MSC representative over the phone +1-866 829-1280(US) to reserve up to four staterooms in one conversation and ensure they are linked. Complete your first room reservation, +1-866 829-1280(US) then select the option on the confirmation page to start another booking for the same sailing. Each room will have its own unique reservation number. A travel agent can manage multiple cabin bookings simultaneously and ensure they are properly grouped. You can book multiple rooms on MSC Cruises by setting up separate transactions +1-866 829-1280(US) or calling customer service, as detailed on the MSC Staterooms Page.
